title: Layouts with Variable Type
slide_intent: Turn a word into a pattern when recognition must happen through shape and repetition as well as reading.
strategic_value: Repeated YUM and CRUNCH forms can make Burger King’s appetite vocabulary function as a graphic identity element.
demonstration: Three portrait panels show repeated YUM, a single vertically stacked YUM and repeated CRUNCH, with width changes filling their fields.
practical_value: Use variable type for a full-page pattern built from one word or repeated words.

content_islands.name: Three type fields
content_islands.spec: Align cream/red, brown/cream and green/cream panels, contrasting repeated rows with stacked letters.

content_islands.name: Example qualification
content_islands.spec: Retain the small review note beneath the panels.

ingredient.name: Variable type pattern
ingredient.role: Make words serve as a large graphic field.
ingredient.application: Build a full-page type composition from one word or repeated sequences using the designed width range.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Generally intended for evocative out-of-home work; the full-page restriction is on page 77. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Application: The page explicitly demonstrates large patterns made from single or repeating words, generally for out-of-home.
reference_purposes.Expression: Variable widths let the words occupy nearly the entire panel.
